Definition: from G1971; a longing for:--earnest (vehement) desire.
BiblicalUsage: Epipothesis is earnest longing, vehement desire — and Paul tells of Titus's earnest desire toward the Corinthians, his mourning and fervent mind; and of the Corinthians' own vehement desire, their zeal and revenge against the sin that had grieved him.
TheologicalSignificance: Longing that leads to repentance is the proof of love, I believe: Titus longed to see them, and they longed to make it right.
